updateAvailableTitle.description: Title of the toast shown on Linux and in the Microsoft Store version when a newer release exists.

updateAvailableDescription.message: Electron Fiddle {{version}} is ready to download.
updateAvailableDescription.description: Body of the update-available toast. {{version}} is the new version number, such as 1.2.0.

download.description: Toast action that opens the release page of the new version in the browser.

crashNoticeTitle.description: Title of the one-time toast on first launch saying that the app sends crash reports.

crashNoticeDescription.message: If Electron Fiddle crashes, it sends a report so the bug can be fixed. Reports never include your code. You can turn them off in Settings.
crashNoticeDescription.description: Body of the first-launch crash reports toast.

crashNoticeAction.description: Toast action that opens Settings at the Privacy section, where crash reports can be turned off.

openSettingsFailed.description: Error toast title when the settings page can't be opened.
